purpose: Preregister the smallest deployable inferred-anchor CYP3A4 candidate before any official R5 outcome is opened: I0 is exactly the frozen R5 F1 nearest-valid-training-anchor control and is retained only if authenticated R5 evidence supports it beyond G0.

r5_resolved_contract.resolution: Apply the exact authenticated v2 and v3 absent-member overlays to v1 in order.

activation.terminal: One immutable official R5 terminal whose exact manifest and result receipts are bound by a separately authenticated r5d_official_attempt_receipt.v1 envelope produced under r5d_official_execution_contract; an R5-shaped terminal or synthetic rehearsal terminal is ineligible.

required_attempt_envelope.official_source_parent_ancestry: Must equal the exact R2B, R3A, R3C and R4 official source-parent receipts frozen by r5d_official_execution_contract; self-declared or synthetic ancestry is invalid.
required_attempt_envelope.attempt_semantics: Must authenticate the one authorized official attempt, no retry or resume, the accepted runner/runtime/checkout receipts, zero blinded-test/TDI/submission/transductive operations, and the exact terminal manifest and result SHA-256 values.
required_attempt_envelope.terminal_cross_binding: The envelope status, resolved R5 contract SHA-256, terminal manifest SHA-256, oracle result SHA-256, output receipts and operation accounting must equal the independently reopened terminal bytes exactly.

activation.authentication_order: First verify the exact r5d_official_execution_contract receipt; then authenticate the separate official-attempt envelope and its official source-parent ancestry; then independently reopen and cross-bind the read-only terminal manifest, exact status-conditioned file set, output receipts, result receipt and parent/source/runtime/accounting bindings before parsing any evidence row.
activation.preactivation: Until the exact official-execution parent, official-attempt envelope and official terminal all authenticate and the terminal status is R5_ORACLE_SIGNAL_PASS, remain I0_PREREG_ONLY and perform no evidence reduction, fit, prediction, test access or submission operation.
activation.nonpass: Any authentic official R5 status other than R5_ORACLE_SIGNAL_PASS resolves directly to I0_DEPLOYMENT_NO_SIGNAL before oracle_scored_rows.csv or oracle_inner_selection.csv is parsed.

permission_resolution.superseded_rule: validation_contract campaign_episodes.public_artifact_role says public episodes and their membership must not be reused for inferred-anchor evaluation.
permission_resolution.narrow_exception: After activation only, I0 may reuse authenticated published R5 derived G0/F1 primary absolute-loss rows, selected T0 coordinates, and published result support. This exception does not expose or authorize any raw R2 episode, membership, mask, anchor, truth, label or observation artifact.

evidence_inputs.oracle_scored_rows.csv: Parse only aligned G0 and F1 rows in the frozen primary selected-anchor population and only their published identifiers, local-availability metadata, aggregation weights and absolute_error; never reconstruct a target or prediction.
evidence_inputs.oracle_inner_selection.csv: Parse only the 15 selected T0 alpha/lambda coordinates.
evidence_inputs.oracle_result.json: Parse only status, contract and terminal bindings, authority, support.control_local_support.F1 and criteria.F1_min_30_families_50_rows.

permission_resolution.other_r5_outputs: oracle_cell_metrics.csv, oracle_bootstrap_summary.csv, oracle_influence_checks.csv and oracle_ablation_scorecard.csv are forbidden evidence inputs; I0 recomputes its two predeclared contrasts from published G0/F1 absolute losses.

candidate_pool_resolution.supersedes: DEFERRED_NO_INFERRED_POOL_V1 for future I0 inference only.
candidate_pool_resolution.scope: Complete finite-central-point CYP3A4 official training molecules only; blinded-test molecules are queries only and never candidates for one another.
candidate_pool_resolution.milestone_state: Defined but not materialized; inferred_anchor_candidate_pools remains zero in this preregistration milestone.

system.alias_of: The exact frozen R5 F1 system under r5_resolved_contract.
system.definition: Use the most Morgan-similar complete CYP3A4 training anchor among the first at most 64 training candidates whose on-demand accepted R4 transformation is VALID_SINGLE or VALID_DOUBLE; tie-break by molecule_id, apply the frozen T0 delta model at the preregistered full-train coordinate, and add the measured training-anchor point.
system.fallback: Use exact full-training G0 only when no valid candidate anchor exists; record local_available=false and prediction_source=G0.
system.integrity_rule: A nonfinite value, invalid fit, receipt drift, schema defect or extraction/model error is I0_FAILED and must not be converted to G0 fallback.

population.alignment: Require exactly one G0 and one F1 row for every key and exact equality of all key and aggregation-weight fields.
population.f1_local: A local F1 row has local_available=true and prediction_source=F1.
population.f1_fallback: Every other F1 row has local_available=false and prediction_source=G0, and its canonical absolute_error equals the aligned G0 absolute_error exactly.

evidence_gate.aggregation: Reuse the frozen R5 primary component macro: mean query absolute error within episode, mean episode loss within component and repeat, mean repeat loss within component, then equal mean across unique components.

contrasts.G0-I0: G0 component-macro MAE minus F1 component-macro MAE on every aligned primary key, including exact F1 fallback rows; positive favors I0.
contrasts.G0-I0_LOCAL: G0 component-macro MAE minus F1 component-macro MAE after applying the f1_local mask to aligned keys; positive favors I0.

bootstrap.rng: numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(20260821)) in the exact accepted R5 root runtime
bootstrap.universe: Every unique primary component_id sorted ascending.
bootstrap.draw: For each attempt draw N component indices with replacement from the sorted N-component universe and reuse that one multiplicity vector for both G0-I0 and G0-I0_LOCAL; the local mask never receives an independent draw.
bootstrap.accept_draw: Accept only when both masked component-macro contrasts are finite and each contains at least one scored component; otherwise consume and reject the draw.
bootstrap.percentile: Sort 2,000 accepted values per contrast; for p in {0.025,0.975}, use linear interpolation at h=(n-1)*p.
bootstrap.failure: Fewer than 2,000 accepted replicates after 20,000 attempts is I0_FAILED.
bootstrap.criterion: The 95% lower bound is strictly positive for both G0-I0 and G0-I0_LOCAL.

cells.population: G0-I0 on the full aligned primary population, including fallback rows.
cells.metric: Within each exact (repeat,outer_fold) cell compute component-macro G0 MAE minus component-macro F1 MAE.
cells.criterion: All 15 cells are finite and present; at least 12 of 15 are strictly positive and at least 3 of 5 are strictly positive within each repeat.

influence.population: Unbootstrapped full aligned primary G0-I0 contrast.
influence.ranking: Compute each component's additive contribution to the unbootstrapped equal-component contrast; rank absolute contribution descending then component_id ascending.
influence.criterion: Remove each of the top 10 components separately, recompute the full G0-I0 contrast, and require every leave-one-component-out contrast to remain strictly positive.

availability.source: Authenticated oracle_result.json support and criteria only.
availability.criterion: The two counts meet their minima and the published F1_min_30_families_50_rows value is exactly true.

final_t0_coordinate.required_rows: Exactly one selected T0 row for each of the 15 (repeat,outer_fold) cells and no duplicate or missing cell.
final_t0_coordinate.selection: Choose the modal exact (alpha,lambda) coordinate across the 15 selected rows; if coordinate frequencies tie, choose larger alpha, then larger lambda.
final_t0_coordinate.non_authority: Inner losses, outer losses, test chemistry and leaderboard feedback cannot alter this coordinate.

full_train_inference.milestone_state: Mechanically preregistered only; no implementation, fit, prediction, test open or submission is authorized by I0_PREREG_ONLY.
full_train_inference.G0: Fit the exact frozen R3 TRACE-G0-MAPL-FIXED model and parameters once on all official training observations with a finite reported central CYP3A4 point.
full_train_inference.T0: Fit the exact frozen R5 T0 features, scaling, contextual ridge and residual hierarchy at final_t0_coordinate on every valid complete-CYP3A4 official training pair, emitting both directions with target analog point minus anchor point.
full_train_inference.pair_weight: For a training component with P eligible unordered pairs, each of its 2*P directional rows has the single fit weight 1/(2*P).

candidate_ranking.universe: Official training molecules with a complete finite reported central CYP3A4 point.
candidate_ranking.pre_extraction_order: Similarity descending, then molecule_id ascending; inspect exactly the first min(64,N) candidates.
candidate_ranking.geometry: Apply the exact receipt-bound accepted R4 extractor independently from each retained training candidate anchor to the current query and retain only VALID_SINGLE or VALID_DOUBLE.
candidate_ranking.selection: Choose the retained valid candidate with greatest Morgan similarity, then molecule_id ascending.
candidate_ranking.test_isolation: A blinded-test molecule is only the current query; it is never an anchor candidate, training row, pair target or source of a test-test relationship.

full_train_inference.prediction: When a valid training anchor exists, return its measured CYP3A4 point plus the finite T0 query-minus-anchor delta and record local_available=true and prediction_source=F1; otherwise return exact G0 and record local_available=false and prediction_source=G0.
full_train_inference.failure: Any receipt, schema, training-population, weighting, coordinate, feature, extraction, fit, or nonfinite-prediction defect is I0_FAILED; only an honestly empty valid-anchor set permits G0 fallback.

operation_accounting.types: Every value is an exact non-boolean nonnegative integer.
operation_accounting.future_evidence_reducer: A separately reviewed reducer may open only the authenticated published files in permission_resolution after activation; it parses published absolute losses but zero targets or predictions and performs zero model fits, test opens, official metric calls, submissions, transductive relationships or candidate-pool materializations.
operation_accounting.future_inference: Full-training fits, candidate-pool materialization and blinded-test prediction require separate implementation and execution gates after I0_DEPLOYMENT_PASS; this preregistration records no such operation.

acceptance.prereg_only: The contract is frozen but no authenticated official R5 outcome has been opened.
acceptance.failed: Any authentication, receipt, schema, alignment, fallback, support, arithmetic, randomization, finiteness or determinism defect.
acceptance.deployment_no_signal: An authentic official R5 status other than R5_ORACLE_SIGNAL_PASS, or an activated clean reduction where any bootstrap, cell, influence or availability criterion is false.
deployment_pass: Both G0-I0 and G0-I0_LOCAL 95% bootstrap lower bounds are strictly positive.
Full-population G0-I0 is positive in at least 12 of 15 cells and at least 3 of 5 cells within each repeat.
Every top-10 full-population G0-I0 leave-one-component-out contrast is strictly positive.
F1 availability covers at least 30 primary components and 50 unique base episode-query rows before repeat expansion, and the published F1_min_30_families_50_rows criterion is true.
The exact modal T0 coordinate and every input, join, loss and accounting value are complete and finite.
acceptance.pass_scope: I0_DEPLOYMENT_PASS authorizes a separate minimal I0 implementation gate only; it is not a fit, prediction, official score or submission result.

hard_stop.r5_nonpass: If the authentic official R5 status is not R5_ORACLE_SIGNAL_PASS, publish I0_DEPLOYMENT_NO_SIGNAL and stop before parsing detailed R5 losses, choosing a coordinate, fitting, opening test chemistry or predicting.
hard_stop.i0_gate_miss: If any clean I0 evidence criterion misses, publish I0_DEPLOYMENT_NO_SIGNAL and permanently remove I0 from the critical path; do not tune a threshold, population, mask, ranker, candidate cap, hyperparameter, bootstrap or fallback from the result.
hard_stop.integrity: I0_FAILED is never reinterpreted as NO_SIGNAL or rescued with G0 fallback; repair requires a new reviewed implementation gate without changing this preregistered science from outcomes.
hard_stop.leaderboard: Leaderboard feedback, official test relationships, TDI, another isoform, a new model and a new metric cannot activate or rescue I0.
